error.schema.json.title: Poppy JSON error
error.schema.json.description: An error with a JSON body from an endpoint this protocol or an extension defines, such as conversations (spec 8.13), feedback (9.3), and the browser-session authorization (6), including invalid_session, session_ended, and version_unsupported (HTTP 400, spec 5.3, 5.5, and 3.4) and extension_required (HTTP 403, 3.3), all also at APIs. extension_required names the extension in extension, direct_conversation_open names the open Direct Conversation in conversation_id (8.10), and version_mismatch gives the conversation's protocol version in protocol_version (8.2). Unknown fields are allowed.
